text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: There is neither betrayal nor tragedy in accumulated defeats.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
For that very process is nothing more than
a prologue leading to ultimate victory.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Bwaaa-hahahahahaha!!
To make the Goddess of Victory smile is our destiny!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Razor-sharp senses, a pounding heartbeat...
Everything that makes me who I am tells the story!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to take the stage and reclaim our ending!
Toward the door of victory shown by the pilot!!!!
